Hai Ba said: My mother-in-law will kill chickens tomorrow, so how should I deal with it?

I said:
- In order not to hurt your mother-in-law's feelings, you can give in and eat some chicken or fish, but absolutely do not kill them alive, but buy ready-made products at the market.However, every day she herself had to recite the rebirth mantra for the chickens and fish, dedicate the merit to them, and reduce her resentment for being killed and eaten.

Hai Ba then negotiated with her mother-in-law.While the baby was breastfeeding, it still cried, but after feeding, it fell asleep silently.Hai Ba thought to himself: "The boy seems to sympathize with his mother's difficult situation!"

Hai Ba's mother was a devout vegetarian and recited Buddha's name. A few days later she came from the Northeast to visit her grandchild.Hai Ba said, as soon as he saw his grandmother, he smiled, but every time he saw his grandmother asking to hold him, he cried, but his grandmother held her hand but did not cry, making his grandmother not understand why?

Hai Ba's biological mother knew the reason why the baby was crying while breastfeeding, so she did not want Hai Ba to continue being forced to eat salty food, so she used the excuse that the rooms here were not spacious and asked her mother-in-law for permission to bring Hai Ba and her grandchild back to the Northeast to raise.

Up to now, seeing the agile and adorable boy growing stronger day by day, everyone in the family is happy.

Explain:
In the sixth chapter of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the Buddha taught: 'In the future, in this Saha World, when a son or daughter is born, if within seven days one recites this Ksitigarbha Sutra and recites the name of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva ten thousand times on behalf of the newborn, then any past karmic offenses of that child will be eradicated, and the child will enjoy peace, happiness, easy upbringing, and longevity.'

If that child already has many blessings, then the happiness and longevity will increase even more.

COMMENTS:
The story of PREGNANT WOMEN REciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra is a testament to the merits of the Ksitigarbha Sutra for the fetus and pregnant women.Hai Ba recited 49 Ksitigarbha sutras and dedicated them to his child. The fetus had less pain, gave birth smoothly (no cesarean section), and the baby was healthy and cried less.When the mother eats salty food, the baby cries and refuses to breastfeed; When the mother is vegetarian, the baby is happy.This proves that the fetus has intuition, knows how to receive merit from the scriptures and reacts to salty foods.The story advises pregnant women: "If you want your child to be healthy and easy to raise, become a vegetarian as soon as possible and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra as a dedication to your child and the unjust family of the previous life."This is a priceless gift that parents can give to their children right from when they are still in the womb.

tieu_de: 13. EATING MEAT OBSTRUCTS A PEACEFUL DEATH
tom_tat: She is over 50 years old and has been chanting Buddha's name for many years but has diabetes due to eating raw crab meat by the sea.Meeting Venerable Dieu Phap, he was taught "Sickness from import", repent and fast.
noi_dung:
{align:center|**EATING MEAT IS COMMONLY GOOD**}

There was a woman in her fifties who had recited the Buddha's name for many years, currently suffering from diabetes. Venerable Dieu Phap said it was because she killed too much that she got sick.

She told me that when she was a child, she was so timid that she didn't even dare to kill a worm.When Master asked her if she often ate raw crab meat by the sea?She was stunned.Immediately reveal everything.

Her daughter was assigned to work in Japan for several years and invited her over for a month each year. Because the mother did not eat land meat, her daughter drove her weekly to coastal seafood restaurants to feast on live seafood. I also explained that eating steamed crab meat is not because I killed it.

Venerable Dieu Phap told her:
- Those sea crabs were steamed to death by the chef because the diners wanted to eat them.

He said again:
– These dishes, whether they were bought by her and found to be dead, or whether they were bought from the freezer, or were cooked for her to eat after being cooked, if strictly speaking, are all counted as the crime of creating the karma of killing.Because if people eat less, killing will also be less.Ultimately, eating animal meat is creating the karma of killing!

The Master saw that she was still confused and did not understand, so he continued to explain:
– There are people who kill a lot, even only doing the job of "assistant killing", but now they are found to be very healthy.But some people have just killed a certain animal, or just eaten a certain type of meat, and the disease occurs again.

The reason is that the karma and blessings each individual accumulates are not the same.Just like there are people who drink 1 kg of white wine every day, every day, for a short period of time it's still okay, but there are people who can't even drink a little wine, even beer, and if they drink it they get drunk.This is because each individual's tolerance for alcohol is different.

But for people who have bad tastes, like to create karma of killing, and like to eat animal flesh, sooner or later the retribution will come!Because of their greed for good food and the desire to enjoy it, people indulge in slaughtering animals. Because of their craving for delicious, bloody food, they invite themselves into resentment and disaster.It should be said: "Imported disease" is like that.

The monk asked her again:
– Does your house have an antique bronze incense burner?
– Yes, she looked very surprised, her eyes staring at the Venerable.

– Where do you keep it?
– Looks like it's on the rooftop!

When she comes home, quickly wash it and let it dry.If anything is an offering, if not used, it needs to be preserved and handled properly.Or give it to someone, don't leave it haphazardly, that's disrespectful.

The Venerable said earnestly:
– I reminded you of two things, if you know your mistakes and repent, your illness will gradually improve.If you truly want to be healthy, you should give up meat and fish entirely and adopt a vegetarian diet. Consuming sentient beings while reciting the Buddha's name means desire remains unsevered and offenses continue unabated. The Buddha's name and the mind are difficult to match.Even if you recite for more than a hundred years, it will be difficult to reach ultimate bliss.

In Hong Kong and the suburbs of Kowloon, people often bring statues of Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara, Patriarch Dharma, Te Cong...Arbitrarily left on the side of the road.Doing so is disrespectful.Please carefully avoid this.I hope you will know your mistakes and correct them immediately. Bodhisattvas are people who are self-aware of their nature and are good at saving people, like Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva, all of whom are great Bodhisattvas who help sentient beings escape suffering.

Human life is full of suffering, fortunately in the sea of ​​suffering there is a Bodhisattva to help.In this life, being able to be close to and hear the Bodhisattva's name is thanks to many lifetimes of cultivating good roots, creating deep virtues and causes, and being able to obtain something precious and difficult to obtain.Bodhisattva is the number one treasure in the human world.If you throw away a Bodhisattva statue on the street, it means throwing away a museum, losing good fortune, and the biggest loss is still yourself.It's really a pity.

COMMENTS:
The story EATING MEAT FOR THE BARRIER OF GENERALITY emphasizes "Imported diseases".She recited Buddha's name for many years but still had diabetes because she ate raw crab meat by the sea (even though it was "boiled in water").Venerable Dieu Phap pointed out: Eating animal meat is creating the karma of killing, and "Imported disease" is an inevitable retribution.Even throwing away Bodhisattva statues on the street is disrespectful and harmful.After repenting and fasting, the illness will improve.The story serves as a wake-up call for those who "recite the Buddha's name while still eating meat": “Consuming sentient beings while reciting the Buddha's name means desire remains unsevered and offenses continue unabated. The Buddha's name and the mind are incompatible."If you want to recite Buddha's name effectively, you must first stop killing and become vegetarian.

tieu_de: 14. RECITING BUDDHIST SUTRAS TO INCREASE WISDOM
tom_tat: Mrs. Ho has heart disease, thought she was a vegetarian but still ate shrimp and crab.Meeting Venerable Dieu Phap, he was told clearly that "fish, shrimp, and crabs are meat", repented, became a true vegetarian, and his heart regained health.
noi_dung:
{align:center|**READ MANY BUDDHA SUTRAS TO INCREASE WISDOM**}

The female fox asked for advice from Venerable Dieu Phap. She had a heart disease for three or four years. Even though she went to the hospital for treatment, things were sometimes good and sometimes bad.Later, through an acquaintance, she was told: 'The Master explains Buddhist principles wonderfully.' If you believe in not eating meat and killing animals, reciting Buddha's name every day and doing good deeds, you can make your heart healthy!"

So she quickly took refuge in Buddhism, but she didn't know when her illness would heal?

Master smiled and asked her:
– Are you not a vegetarian?
– Yes, I'm a vegetarian!– She affirmed.

– I still feel like she is eating fish, shrimp and crab!Especially like to eat crayfish.Not only does she like to eat, but she also introduces friends to restaurant X to eat and also praises and advertises that restaurant X's cooking is very delicious.Did she do that or not?

Layman Ho heard Master's words, shed tears and asked:
- Oh!Master, fish, shrimp, crab...Does that count as meat?I still think I'm a vegetarian!

Master said:
– Fish, shrimp, crab…If it's not meat, what do you think it is?Is it vegetables?Disciples of the Buddha observe precepts not to eat meat and to avoid the five pungent roots (onions, leeks, garlic...). You must know that not eating salty meat includes animals that have life and flesh and blood.Fish, shrimp, and crabs are animals!They still have lives.She must stop eating salty foods and eat vegetarian food properly, then her illness will improve.

- Yes!Dear Master.From now on I will start again, I will not eat animals including fish, shrimp, crabs - Mrs. Ho said.

Master explained again:
– Disciples of the Buddha must not only uphold precepts against killing by abstaining from meat, alcohol, and smoking themselves, but must also avoid introducing others to meat feasts, tobacco, or drinking, let alone dealing commercially in such trades. Because trading alcohol, drugs, meat...for people to use or eat - It's a crime!– Just like not smoking yourself but selling it to someone who smokes, the error is the same.Because she introduced people to eat salty food, she must realize that mistake and repent.

– Master, I understand clearly.From now on, not only will I become a vegetarian myself, but I will also not encourage others to eat salty foods anymore.

I sat next to Master and Mrs. Ho. I couldn't help but contribute:
– Does your heart feel more comfortable?
She was stunned for a moment, then understood what I meant and excitedly said:
– Oh my, it's so relaxing.I haven't felt this light and healthy in a long time!

Practicing Buddhism and vegetarianism is not merely for curing ailments; most importantly, it is to comprehend the fundamental truth of the universe and human existence.

You should read the series: "Prajnaparamita Sutra, Ksitigarbha Sutra, Dharma Jewel Platform", and "Luong Hoang Sam Sutra"...There is also the "Shurangama Sutra", this is a sutra that helps open wisdom, clearly distinguishing 50 types of demonic speech.By looking at the sutras, you can judge for yourself whether your actions are in accordance with the Dharma or not?That's why it is said: "Only by reading the sutras can wisdom increase."

COMMENTS:
The story of READING MANY BUDDHA SUTRAS TO INCREASE WISDOM is a lesson about "True vegetarianism".Mrs. Ho thought she was a vegetarian but still ate shrimp and crab, and even introduced her friends to the seafood store - that was "auxiliary killing".When Venerable Dieu Phap pointed out that "fish, shrimp, and crabs are living animals", she shed tears of repentance.As a result, the heart gets healthy immediately.The story also recommends reading many sutras (Prajnaparamita Sutra, Ksitigarbha Sutra, Shurangama Sutra...)to increase wisdom and distinguish between right and wrong.This is a reminder: "Being vegetarian is not just about not eating the meat of animals with bones, but about cutting off all living things."People who recite Buddha's name and want their illness to improve should first become a true vegetarian and read sutras to open up their wisdom.

tom_tat: Doctor Hoang suffered from a strange illness (at night he punched and kicked, in the morning he was normal) because his father in the evil world relied on his son's body to ask for help.Meeting Venerable Dieu Phap, the father was saved, the son took refuge and his illness was cured.
noi_dung:
{align:center|**DEAR FATHER, SUPER DEMAND**}

There was a doctor named Hoang who had a very strange disease. When it was dark, his eyes would freeze, he wouldn't speak, he wouldn't sleep, but he would punch and kick...But as soon as it was morning, he returned to normal.

It is said that since the onset of his illness, 6 specialists have come to examine him, but all of them have failed.His wife also tried contemporary qigong treatment, but Dr. Hoang did not believe it and basically refused to go.

After that, Dr. Hoang's wife was enthusiastically introduced by Professor Ly, so she decided to go to the Venerable to see the patient for him.

Mrs. Hoang said her husband doesn't even believe in qigong, so I'm afraid he can't come for the Venerable to see because her husband always thinks "it's all superstition!"

Later, when she got home, Mrs. Hoang told this story to test her husband's opinion.Doctor Hoang's eyes lit up and he frantically asked:
– What did you say the Venerable's name was?

When he heard the words: "Monk Dieu Phap", he was so impatient that he could not wait, insisted on contacting Professor Ly, and even expressed his wish to worship the Venerable as his teacher.

A few days later, I, along with Professor Ly, Doctor Hoang and his wife, boarded the car to Ngu Dai Son to pay our respects to the Venerable before dark.Because I asked to call ahead, Master was prepared.

Master asked Doctor Hoang.
– Are your parents still alive or dead?
Mrs. Hoang replied on behalf of her husband: - Yes, it's been almost two years since he passed away...

Master said:
– You also have two brothers, but your father loves you the most?

At this time, because it was already dark, Dr. Hoang's eyes began to close and he did not say anything.

The wife still replied:
– Master, you are right, my two brothers live in the old country, and my husband lives in the city.Since childhood, my husband and I loved him the most.

The Venerable explained:
- When his father was born, his killing karma was quite heavy, so after death he had to suffer in the evil realm.He knew that his son had an affinity with the Buddha Dharma and could rescue him, so he had appeared in his dreams. But he doesn't believe it.Therefore, to escape suffering, he reluctantly had to apply the "rely on the child's body" strategy.to force it to go to Buddha's door to ask for help.Look, the magic doctor's eyes have now become normal, right?

At this time everyone turned to look at Doctor Hoang, his face had become rosy and bright.The eyes are flexible again as usual.

Teacher continued:
– Wait a minute, first you should take him to the main hall to worship Buddha.

The next day, a memorial tablet will be set up for his father at the "Kingsitigarbha Palace". Thanks to the power of the monks' chanting, his father will be free from suffering and attain happiness.

Suddenly, Doctor Hoang suddenly knelt down at the Venerable's feet, his expression resolute, pleading:
– Master, I want to worship you as my teacher!Please accept me!

When Mrs. Hoang heard that, her face showed worry and tension, not knowing what to do.

I only saw the Venerable smiling and saying:
– Okay, please become a lay disciple of Buddhism!

When I explained to Mrs. Hoang what a "home disciple" was, she breathed a sigh of relief. All this time she was worried that because of a misunderstanding, she thought her husband was demanding...renunciation!

We also bowed to Master and brought offerings to the main hall, worshiping the Buddha as one.

That night we stayed in the reception room outside the temple.After more than half a year of turmoil, Dr. Hoang finally slept peacefully.

Currently, Dr. Hoang is practicing very diligently and diligently.He had always been quiet by nature, but when he heard people praising him, his face lit up and he happily said:
– This is thanks to me using "disaster" to get "blessed"!

The experienced doctor was once a victim and experienced firsthand a strange disease that medicine could not cure.It was thanks to the help of high-ranking monks who attained enlightenment that his father's karma was eliminated and he was able to deepen his relationship with Buddhism today.

COMMENTS:
The story of THE FATHER'S REQUEST FOR SUPERVISION is a lesson about "The unjust family of the past life - relying on the corpse of the child to ask for help".Dr. Huang suffered from a bizarre illness (thrashing violently at night, normal during the day) because his deceased father, trapped in evil realms, relied on his son's physical form to press him to seek spiritual deliverance through the Dharma. When my father set up a tablet at Ksitigarbha Palace and chanted the sutra for transcendence, my illness was cured immediately.The story emphasizes: "If there is a disease, you have to find the root" - it is not always a physical disease, but it can be a previous family's injustice or the ghost of a relative asking for help.Reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra and setting up a transcendental tablet for parents and ancestors is a great merit, both helping them to escape suffering and alleviating disasters for their children and grandchildren.This is the reason why many people, after repenting their injustice or saving their relatives, their illnesses and misfortunes disappear.

tieu_de: 16. THE UNBORN CHILD LOVES HEARING THE KSITIGARBHA SUTRA
tom_tat: Tran's daughter was pregnant, and her fetus often kicked in pain.Advised to recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra, giving birth smoothly, the baby is healthy and knows how to "sympathize" when the mother is vegetarian.
noi_dung:
{align:center|**THE UNBORN CHILD LOVES LISTENING TO THE Earth Organ Sutra**}

Tran Nu Si is my neighbor. She recently confided: "My daughter is more than seven months pregnant. Recently, the fetus in her womb often kicks and kicks, causing her mother extreme pain."

I told her, according to Buddha's teachings, the child in her womb is a cruel person who comes to collect debt and torture her.It could also be caused by the karma of killing and eating meat.It's best from today on, pregnant women should stop eating meat (that is, stop eating salty foods and become completely vegetarian). She told me to recite a set of Ksitigarbha Sutras for the sake of the fetus.Just chant with one mind and reverence, it will have good results.

I also added:
- If the pregnant woman is determined to recite the seven Ksitigarbha sutras for her child, it will clear the family injustice between mother and child, but if after reciting the Ksitigarbha sutra it is not effective, then I will let your daughter eat the meat again...

Next, I gave her the Ksitigarbha Sutra to take home for my daughter to recite.

The next day, Ms. Tran happily thanked me.She said:
– Last night, I went home and told my grandchild what he said. After he heard it, he immediately took a bath and started chanting the Ksitigarbha Sutra.After chanting, the fetus was seen to be quiet and did not fight anymore.Finally, last night my daughter slept peacefully.This is an unprecedented feat in recent months.

At the same time, her child also gave up the habit of eating salty foods.Female monk Chen praised again and said:
– The Buddha's teaching is so profoundly efficacious! If only my daughter had known earlier and recited the sutras in daily life, she would never have endured such suffering!

Not long after, Tran's daughter gave birth to a lovely baby boy.Giving birth is almost painless.During the month of quarantine, every day I recited a set of Ksitigarbha Sutras.Previously, pregnant women loved salty foods, but strangely, now whenever they hear about meat, they hate it.Miss Tran asked me why?

I said I don't like the smell of meat, it's because of the merit of reciting sutras that my body and mind are purified.Causes the inherent Buddha nature to manifest itself, no longer wanting to accept the flesh and blood of sentient beings.Her daughter now only needs to eat more vegetarian foods and vegetables, her body will definitely be better than before.

COMMENTS:
The story THE FETAL FACILITIES LISTENING TO THE Ksitigarbha Sutra continues the spirit of story 12, affirming the merits of the Ksitigarbha Sutra for the fetus.The fetus often kicks in pain because of "harsh debt collection", but when the mother chants the Ksitigarbha dedication sutra, the baby kicks less, gives birth smoothly, and after birth learns to "sympathize" when the mother fasts (does not cry when drinking vegetarian milk).When the mother eats salty food, the baby cries and refuses to breastfeed.This proves that the fetus has a premonition, knows how to receive merit and react to the karma of killing.The story advises pregnant women and their families: "If you want your child to be healthy and easy to raise, start a vegetarian diet soon and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra to dedicate it to your child."This is the best way to clear the family's injustice from the previous life and create happiness for the child right from the start of pregnancy.

tom_tat: Ly's mother-in-law had leg pain when walking because she loved eating stewed pork feet.Meeting Venerable Dieu Phap, he was clearly shown "What goes around comes around", repenting and fasting will cure your illness.

COMMENTS:

tieu_de: 18. THE FETUS HEARS THE SUTRA AND DISSOLVES RESENTMENT
tom_tat: When Chung Hong was pregnant, the fetus often kicked in pain because he was an unjust family member from the previous generation (his grandfather was a butcher who killed pigs).By reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, the fetus eliminates karma, ascends to the heavenly realm, and no longer holds resentment.
noi_dung:
{align:center|**THE FETAL LISTES TO THE SUTRAS AND RESOLVES ANGER**}

Manh Vi and Chung Hong are a couple who share the same belief in Buddhism.After getting married, they were of one heart and mind, reciting sutras and upholding precepts together as an exemplary Buddhist family, living in great harmony admired by fellow practitioners.

Chung Hong's girlfriend is Lan, about the same age as her, and was married before.During her pregnancy, thanks to Lan Chi Thanh chanting the Ksitigarbha Sutra and Pho Mon Sutra, advising her family not to kill animals for her to nourish, thanks to that, Lan and her husband continued to give birth to beautiful and adorable children.(Babies born thanks to their parents' chanting often have the same characteristics: they are very smart, pretty, flexible, smile often and cry rarely, not bothering their parents).

When Chung Hong became pregnant, out of love for their child, the couple began chanting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, hoping to give birth to a beautiful, deep-rooted, good-natured baby.

During pregnancy, the fetus in Chung Hong's belly often reacted violently, the baby acted violently towards the mother, causing her to feel nauseous, frustrated, swollen, and have pain in the sciatic nerve...Can't eat well, can't sleep well at night.In short, she experienced more suffering than other pregnant women.

The only comforting thought was that on the night before delivery, the final checkup showed fetal heartbeat and vital signs were completely normal. The doctor estimated that the birth date would be on the first day of the Lunar New Year, a day that would make the whole family even happier.

On New Year's Eve, every family happily reunited, the sound of firecrackers exploded, and the baby in Chung Hong's belly also gesticulated and fought wildly.Chung Hong's mother-in-law said:
– This kid looks like he's really excited to go play with firecrackers!

Her joke made everyone laugh.

But things were impermanent, and when it was time to give birth, it was discovered that the baby had died because the umbilical cord was wrapped around its neck.Died on New Year's Eve, died after the last strong movement.While everyone was excited, excited, waiting for the baby to be born.

This bad news is truly like thunder exploding in a clear sky.Not only did it make Chung Hong and his wife extremely surprised and miserable, but it also made me extremely surprised and confused, unable to understand.

That morning, when Chung Hong was admitted to the hospital waiting to give birth and received the bad news that the fetus had died last night, I was so "shocked" that I completely forgot it was the first day of the new year.

When he saw a young father waiting in front of the delivery room, he knew he would never hear the cry of his baby being born.A young mother waited for labor, but she knew she would never be able to touch her baby's living body again.At that time, I truly couldn't think of any words in the world to comfort them.

Confronted with this tragedy, I could not comprehend why such sincere Buddhists had to endure the painful calamity of losing their newborn. This not only caused both sets of parents to lose faith in Buddhism, but relatives also lashed out, criticizing Meng Wei and Zhong Hong for superstitious belief, threatening to derail their spiritual resolve.

Therefore, even though I was in the front room, I still called and told Venerable Dieu Phap everything.

Beyond imagination, upon hearing the news, the Master did not utter words of condolence, but instead proclaimed: 'Wonderful, wonderful!'

He also sent me to find Manh Vi and ask immediately if his grandfather worked as a butcher and killed many pigs in the past?

Master also explained to me:
- This fetus is truly an unjust family, a grudge - determined to come and collect their debt - Therefore, from the moment the consciousness entered the fetus, it tortured the pregnant woman every day, causing the whole family not to have a moment of peace.However, because the couple Manh Vi and Chung Hong sincerely repented, recited the Buddha's name, and chanted sutras... Therefore, the fetus gradually accepts Buddha Dharma.Furthermore, parents recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra for the sake of the fetus.But this sutra: "SPECIALIZED IN HELPING IN ELIMINATION OF karma that blocks money".Thanks to that, during nearly ten months of listening to the sutra, the fetus really benefited.Because karma was eliminated, his heart also eliminated the hatred and anger towards his grandfather Manh Vi, completely eliminating the idea of ​​​​wanting to find his current descendants and take revenge.Now that the fetus's soul has ascended to heaven to practice, it no longer comes back to earth to seek revenge from its enemies.

I asked:
– Then why does the fetus die when it is about to be born?

– There are two reasons, one: Mother and child's fate has not ended yet.Two: the fetus likes to listen to the Dharma Sutra.That's why it persevered until the last minute before letting go.Conversely, had this couple not believed in Buddhism and sincerely recited sutras, this child would not have died; it would have been born safely, but as the child grew up, the entire family would have suffered ever-increasing torment and ruin. In the end, the Manh family will fall into the "family ruin" situation, will be completely destroyed at the hands of this child.Therefore, when the fetus dies, everyone who looks at it thinks it is unfortunate, the whole family is filled with pain and suffering, but actually you are enjoying blessings and eliminating disasters.This is something worth congratulating!

After listening to Master's explanation, my spirit was uplifted and the dark clouds of doubt dissipated.I immediately went to Manh Vi, who was immersed in sadness, and immediately verified everything Master had just asked me to ask, and it turned out that it was all true.

Manh Vi recognized that when he was young, his grandfather specialized in making a living as a pig butcher.Before he died, he also had a very strange illness.Not only did he order and ask people to hang him up, but he constantly used a mace to hit him. He said that only if he did that would he feel comfortable.He died very painfully, not only was he spitting out blood but his eyes were extremely fierce.In the past, Manh Vi never mentioned his grandfather's tragic death to outsiders.

Then Manh Vi told a story about Mr. Hung, a friend of his grandfather's who worked as a cow butcher, killing several animals every day.Mr. Hung became rich thanks to this profession.One day, Mr. Hung came home from going out, and as soon as he went home to rest, he suddenly complained of tightness in his chest and difficulty breathing.Later, his wife came to visit and found him lying motionless on the bed, unable to wake up, calling without answering.So he invited the doctor to come.

When the doctor arrived, he saw Mr. Xiong howling in agony like a slaughtered ox, his whole body convulsing violently until he vomited blood and expired. He had been dead for a while, fresh blood was still pouring out of his mouth.Looking at that scene, everyone was scared.Mr. Hung's descendants listened to his father's advice and closed down the slaughterhouse and no longer followed the killing profession.

Manh Vi said that he had witnessed many death scenes of people working in the cattle slaughter business and saw that most of them, whether they died young or old, died very miserably and before dying, their mouths always spit out fresh blood.

This is also the reason why he single-mindedly studied Buddhism.All of Manh Vi's uncles, aunts, and uncles were chronically ill. His father had pain in his spine and cartilage, and his uncle was paralyzed and bedridden for ten years.During Meng Wei's lifetime, his brother was not yet forty when he suffered from a mental illness, and was always suspicious of people saying bad things behind his back.He couldn't work, and Manh Vi and his sister always had spinal pain. His sister had to have surgery, but it couldn't be cured.

Venerable Miao Fa added that were it not for Meng Wei's dedication to vegetarianism and Buddhist cultivation, it would have been nearly impossible for him to marry in the first place. Because the family's karma of killing is too deep, it is destined that the children and grandchildren will be sick and weak.

The Dharma sermon that Venerable Dieu Phap just gave, is like a timely rain, pouring out the evil fire that is burning and burning everyone's hearts.Eliminate all doubts in their hearts.Especially for Manh Vi and Chung Hong, their sorrow turned into joy; both husband and wife are now studying the Dharma and practicing with even greater vigor. I believe that if they are so sincere, the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas will also bless them to give birth to noble children soon.

COMMENTS:
The story of THE FEMINI LISTENING TO THE SUTRAS AND RESOLVING THE HURRY is one of the most touching and profound stories about "The previous family's injustice - the fetus collects debt".Chung Hong's fetus often suffered pain because he was the unjust family member of Manh Vi's grandfather (a pig butcher).But thanks to the parents chanting the Ksitigarbha Sutra throughout the pregnancy, the fetus eliminated karma, resolved resentment, ascended to the heavenly realm of practice, and no longer came back to take revenge.The fact that the fetus died on New Year's Eve (a day that was supposed to be a happy day) was actually a "disaster turned into a blessing" - saving the entire Manh family from "destruction and death."The story affirms: "The Ksitigarbha Sutra specializes in helping eliminate negative karma."Every parent wants their children to be healthy, so they should fast early and recite the Ksitigarbha Sutra to dedicate their lives to their children and their previous families' injustices - that is the greatest gift for their children and for the whole family.
